title: msilo Module
content_markdown: This modules provides offline message storage for the Open SIP Server. It stores received messages for an offline user and sends them when the user becomes online.
overview: This modules provides offline message storage for the Open SIP Server. It stores received messages for an offline user and sends them when the user becomes online.
how_it_works:
For each message, the modules stores “Request-URI” (“R-URI”) only if it is a complete address of record (“username@hostname”), URI from “To” header, URI from “From” header, incoming time, expiration time, content type and body of the message. If “R-URI” is not an address of record (it might be the contact address for current SIP session) the URI from “To” header will be used as R-URI.

When the expiration time passed, the message is discarded from database. Expiration time is computed based on incoming time and one of the module's parameters.

Every time when a user registers with OpenSIPS, the module is looking in database for offline messages intended for that user. All of them will be sent to contact address provided in REGISTER request.

It may happen the SIP user to be registered but his SIP User Agent to have no support for MESSAGE request. In this case it should be used the “failure_route” to store the undelivered requests.

Another functionality provided by the modules is to send messages at a certain time -- the reminder functionality. Using config logic, a received message can be stored and delivered at a time specified while storing with the 'snd_time_avp'.

dependencies_required.name: database module
dependencies_required.reason: implements the “db” interface and provides support for storing/receiving data to/from a database system

exported_parameters.name: db_url
exported_parameters.description: Database URL.

exported_parameters.name: db_table
exported_parameters.description: The name of table where to store the messages.

exported_parameters.name: from_address
exported_parameters.description: The SIP address used to inform users that destination of their message is not online and the message will be delivered next time when that user goes online. If the parameter is not set, the module will not send any notification. It can contain pseudo-variables.

exported_parameters.name: contact_hdr
exported_parameters.description: The value of the Contact header (including header name and ending \r\n) to be added in notification messages. It can contain pseudo-variables.

exported_parameters.name: offline_message
exported_parameters.description: The body of the notification message. It can contain pseudo-variables.
exported_parameters.example_code: modparam("msilo", "offline_message", "*** User $rU is offline!") modparam("msilo", "offline_message", "I am offline!")

exported_parameters.name: content_type_hdr
exported_parameters.description: The value of the Content-Type header (including header name and ending \r\n) to be added in notification messages. It must reflect what the 'offline_message' contains. It can contain pseudo-variables.

exported_parameters.name: reminder
exported_parameters.description: The SIP address used to send reminder messages. If this value is not set, the reminder feature is disabled.

exported_parameters.name: outbound_proxy
exported_parameters.description: The SIP address used as next hop when sending the message. Very useful when using OpenSIPS with a domain name not in DNS, or when using a separate OpenSIPS instance for msilo processing. If not set, the message will be sent to the address in destination URI.

exported_parameters.name: expire_time
exported_parameters.description: Expire time of stored messages - seconds. When this time passed, the message is silently discarded from database.

exported_parameters.name: check_time
exported_parameters.description: Timer interval to check if dumped messages are sent OK - seconds. The module keeps each request send by itself for a new online user and if the reply is 2xx then the message is deleted from database.

exported_parameters.name: send_time
exported_parameters.description:
Timer interval in seconds to check if there are reminder messages. The module takes all reminder messages that must be sent at that moment or before that moment.

If the value is 0, the reminder feature is disabled.

exported_parameters.name: clean_period
exported_parameters.description: Number of “check_time” cycles when to check if there are expired messages in database.

exported_parameters.name: use_contact
exported_parameters.description: Turns on/off the usage of the Contact address to send notification back to sender whose message is stored by MSILO.

exported_parameters.name: sc_mid
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing message id.

exported_parameters.name: sc_from
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing the source address.

exported_parameters.name: sc_to
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing the destination address.

exported_parameters.name: sc_uri_user
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing the user name.

exported_parameters.name: sc_uri_host
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing the domain.

exported_parameters.name: sc_body
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column storing the message body in silo table.

exported_parameters.name: sc_ctype
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing content type.

exported_parameters.name: sc_exp_time
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing the expire time of the message.

exported_parameters.name: sc_inc_time
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing the incoming time of the message.

exported_parameters.name: sc_snd_time
exported_parameters.description: The name of the column in silo table, storing the send time for the reminder.

exported_parameters.name: snd_time_avp
exported_parameters.description: The name of an AVP which may contain the time when to sent the received message as reminder.The AVP is used ony by m_store(). If the parameter is not set, the module does not look for this AVP. If the value is set to a valid AVP name, then the module expects in the AVP to be a time value in format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (e.g., 20060101201500).

exported_parameters.name: add_date
exported_parameters.description: Wheter to add as prefix the date when the message was stored.

exported_parameters.name: max_messages
exported_parameters.description: Maximum number of stored message for an AoR. Value 0 equals to no limit.

exported_functions.name: m_store

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: a SIP URI in whose inbox the message will be stored. If "owner" is missing, the SIP address is taken from R-URI.

exported_functions.description: The method stores certain parts of the current SIP request (it should be called when the request type is MESSAGE and the destination user is offline or his UA does not support MESSAGE requests). If the user is registered with a UA which does not support MESSAGE requests you should not use mode=“0” if you have changed the request uri with the contact address of user's UA.

exported_functions.name: m_dump

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: a SIP URI whose inbox will be dumped. If "owner" is missing, the SIP address is taken from To URI.

parameters.name: maxmsg
parameters.description: is a maximum number of messages to be dumped.

exported_functions.description: The method sends stored messages for the SIP user that is going to register to his actual contact address. The method should be called when a REGISTER request is received and the “Expire” header has a value greater than zero.

exported_statistics.name: stored_messages
exported_statistics.description: The number of messages stored by msilo.

exported_statistics.name: failed_messages
exported_statistics.description: The number of failed dumped messages.

exported_statistics.name: dumped_reminders
exported_statistics.description: The number of dumped reminder messages.

exported_statistics.name: failed_reminders
exported_statistics.description: The number of failed reminder messages.

configuration_examples.explanation:
Meaning of the parameters is as follows:
owner (string, optional) - a SIP URI in whose inbox the message will be stored. If "owner" is missing, the SIP address is taken from R-URI.
This function can be used from REQUEST_ROUTE, FAILURE_ROUTE.

configuration_examples.description: The method sends stored messages for the SIP user that is going to register to his actual contact address. The method should be called when a REGISTER request is received and the “Expire” header has a value greater than zero.
configuration_examples.explanation:
Meaning of the parameters is as follows:
owner (string, optional) - a SIP URI whose inbox will be dumped. If "owner" is missing, the SIP address is taken from To URI.
maxmsg (int, optional) - is a maximum number of messages to be dumped.
This function can be used from REQUEST_ROUTE, STARTUP_ROUTE, TIMER_ROUTE, EVENT_ROUTE
